\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = W_{(k)},
\qquad
k = \begin{cases}
\text{the rank} & \text{by rank} \\
\lfloor n p / 100 \rfloor + 1 & \text{by percentile, } p < 100 \\
n & p = 100
\end{cases}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(W_{(k)}\): The k-th smallest value of the window
- \(n\): Number of values in the window
- \(p\): Percentile from 0 to 100
- \(k\): Rank from 1 to n

W is the list of the n = size squared values in the window. W with index (k) is its k-th smallest value. Rank 1 gives the min filter, rank n gives the max filter, and rank (n + 1) / 2 gives the median. The percentile rule is the one of scipy.ndimage.percentile_filter.
